svg.title: Front of the perfboard: boost converter, XIAO ESP32-C3 and current sink, LM358 and relays, with every jumper tagged J1 to J13
svg.text: Parts side. HV bus on column 4, ground on column 6, XIAO USB-C pointing right. Dashed lines are bare-wire bridges on the back.
S1 · top · boost converter and relay 1
S2 · middle · XIAO and current sink
Red column 4 is the HV bus and blue column 6 is ground, on all three sections. The header rows U and T (top) and V and W (bottom) are joined per column.
Gold dot: a leg or wire lands here. Dashed: bare-wire bridge on the back. Coloured jumpers: red for HV and battery, grey for ground, blue for signals.
A jumper that goes to another section is drawn as two tags, one at each end. J1 to J13 are listed in docs/HARDWARE.md.
